name: scdaw_manage_fx
description: Add, update, reset, or remove an audio effect ('fold', 'crusher', 'stereoTool', 'delay', 'reverb', 'compressor', 'revamp') or MIDI effect ('arpeggio', 'pitch', 'velocity') on a track.

action.description: Action to perform on track FX rack

fxId.description: Specific FX instance ID (optional if fxType is unique)

params.description: Effect parameter key-value pairs to set or update
